_about: File-level type of every file in samples/. 'rule' = Acts, Rules, manuals (CSMOP), guidelines, circulars, memos, notifications. 'case' = orders, letters, judgments, tenders. 'reference' = glossaries: indexed but never in the rules/cases lists (for term help later). Set by hand, never guessed from content. Files not listed here are indexed as 'case' with a warning.

_page_types._about: Page ranges [first, last] (1-based PDF pages, inclusive) inside a rule book that hold forms, formats, annexures, appendices or sample letters, not rules. They go in the past-cases list. Read off the page headings by hand (FORM n / FORMAT n / APPENDIX n.n), never guessed at run time.
